scope: After the natural challenger is frozen, select 32 Act 3 entries from each natural test cohort ordered by SHA256 of the published salt and seed, or all if fewer. From the same secured Act 3 entry, use the native scenario command to enter MECHA_KNIGHT_ELITE with the carried deck, HP, relics and potions intact. Play both policies. These deliberately placed fights form a separate held-out practice diagnostic and never count as natural boss arrivals.
native_training: Use genuine Mecha Knight starts wherever available and separately labeled native practice from 21 training maps; reserve 14 other maps for selection. Potion-inventory interventions are labeled.
